This sleek crimson colored yacht served as the personal '''starship''' of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]]. The family's crest was emblazoned upon the side of the vessel. It was later destroyed by [[Palpatine/Legends|the eldest son]] of the family upon murdering his [[Cosinga Palpatine|father]], [[Palpatine's mother|mother]], [[Palpatine's siblings|siblings]], and their bodyguards, and the destruction was later covered up as an accident.<ref name="Darth P" />
